title: Purgeable memory object key envelope v1
description: A closed, secret-free wrapper record for one random object DEK. Content uses AES-256-GCM-SIV, the DEK uses nonce-free AES-256 Key Wrap, and dek_id is a truncated KEK-keyed HMAC fingerprint used only for collision detection. The wrapped key is useful only with the externally held KEK identified by kek_id. Deleting every copy of this record is the cryptographic-erasure operation.
